name: io.github.ohneben/hubspot-mcp
title: HubSpot
description: HubSpot MCP server: the whole public API (1,000+ endpoints across CRM, CMS, Marketing, Automation, Commerce and more) as safety-categorized, hub/plan-aware tools (Docker + Streamable HTTP).

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: HubSpot private-app access token (pat-...) from Settings -> Integrations -> Private Apps (an OAuth access token also works).

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API host. Default https://api.hubapi.com; use https://api-eu1.hubapi.com for EU data residency portals.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required on the /mcp endpoint. Required whenever HOST is not a loopback address, otherwise the server refuses to start.
